'''''A Passage to Infinity: Medieval Indian Mathematics from Kerala and Its Impact'' '''<ref name="Passage">{{cite book|last=Joseph|first=George Gheverghese|title=A Passage to Infinity : Medieval Indian Mathematics from Kerala and Its Impact|publisher=Sage Publications (Inda) Pvt. Ltd. |location=Delhi|date=2009|pages=236|isbn=978-81-321-0168-0}}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal |last=Plofker |first=Kim |author-link=Kim Plofker |date=2015-12-21 |title=A Passage to Infinity: Medieval Indian Mathematics from Kerala and Its Impact |url=https://jps.library.utoronto.ca/index.php/aestimatio/article/view/26020 |journal=Aestimatio: Critical Reviews in the History of Science |volume=10 |pages=56–62 |doi=10.33137/aestimatio.v10i0.26020 |issn=1549-4497|doi-access=free }}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal |last=Sriram |first=M.S. |date=2011 |title=Book Review: A Passage to Infinity—Medieval Indian Mathematics and Its Impact |url=http://journals.sagepub.com/doi/10.1177/037698361103800207 |journal=Indian Historical Review |language=en |volume=38 |issue=2 |pages=247–250 |doi=10.1177/037698361103800207 |s2cid=149427309 |issn=0376-9836|url-access=subscription }}</ref> is a 2009 book by [[George Gheverghese Joseph]] chronicling the social and mathematical origins of the [[Kerala school of astronomy and mathematics]]. The book discusses the highlights of the achievements of [[Kerala school of astronomy and mathematics|Kerala school]] and also analyses the hypotheses and conjectures on  the possible transmission of Kerala mathematics to [[Europe]].

==An outline of the contents==

# Introduction 
# The Social Origins of the [[Kerala school of astronomy and mathematics|Kerala School]] 
# The Mathematical Origins of the [[Kerala school of astronomy and mathematics|Kerala School]]
# The Highlights of [[Kerala]] [[Mathematics]] and [[Astronomy]]
# [[History of trigonometry#Indian mathematics|Indian Trigonometry]]: From Ancient Beginnings to [[Nilakantha Somayaji|Nilakantha]]
# [[Squaring the circle|Squaring the Circle]]: The Kerala Answer
# Reaching for the Stars: The [[Power Series]] for [[Sine]]s and [[Cosine]]s
# Changing Perspectives on [[Indian Mathematics]] 
# Exploring Transmissions: A Case Study of Kerala Mathematics
# A Final Assessment
